{"markdown":"# Issues Memo — Master Services Agreement (Kubient)

**Document:** Exhibit 10.14, Master Services Agreement dated 5 February  
**We represent:** Customer  
**Prepared by:** In-house counsel  

---

## 1. Executive summary

We reviewed the Master Services Agreement against our playbook. Of the eighteen positions tested, eleven are compliant and require no redline, five are deviations, and two items are missing entirely.

The commercial architecture is largely acceptable: there is no exclusivity, no non-compete, no minimum commitment, no MFN, no non-solicit, no liquidated damages or early-termination fee, no audit right running against us, and assignment (including to an affiliate or successor by merger, stock or asset sale) is permitted without consent. Vendor's indemnity is broad and covers IP infringement, with standard notice, control and cooperation procedures.

The concerns are concentrated in three areas. First, **liability is uncapped for both parties** — Section 7 excludes indirect and consequential damages but contains no aggregate cap. Second, **ownership of Customer Data and deliverables is never addressed**, despite Vendor collecting, storing and managing visitor data and delivering "deliverables" under Section 9(b). Third, the **exit mechanics are weak**: no convenience termination, a 90-day notice window, no non-renewal mechanic, and a wind-down clause (Section 4(c)) that permits destruction of our data with no transition assistance or export obligation. We also note an internal conflict between the mandatory AAA arbitration clause (Section 8) and the exclusive New York court venue in Section 14(a), and the complete absence of any insurance requirement.

---

## 2. Findings

| # | Severity | Rule | Status | Section | Issue / position |
|---|----------|------|--------|---------|------------------|
| 1 | Critical | IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data | Deviation | Preamble | The only ownership provision covers names, trademarks and logos; ownership of Customer Data, Requests, Content and deliverables is unaddressed. We add an ownership sentence for Customer Data and deliverables, a licence-back for embedded Vendor IP, and a no-joint-ownership statement. |
| 2 | Critical | LOL-CAP — Limitation of liability | Deviation | Preamble | Section 7 provides only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages; there is no aggregate cap, leaving unlimited direct liability. We add the playbook mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000) with Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) outside the cap, and confirm payment obligations are not "damages". |
| 3 | Critical | INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor | Compliant | Preamble | Broad Vendor defence and indemnity covering the Services, Auction Platform, Creative, breach of representations and warranties (including the Section 9(b)(i) non-infringement warranty) and its acts or omissions, with Section 11 procedures. No redline. |
| 4 | High | LICENSE — Licence grant scope | Deviation | Preamble | Grant is revocable, non-transferable and non-assignable and names Customer only; Section 6(a) bars third-party access absent Vendor consent. We extend the grant to affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, make it transferable to a successor, delete "revocable" and limit revocation to termination or our uncured material breach. |
| 5 | High | T4C — Termination for convenience | Deviation | Preamble | No Customer convenience right beyond a 90-day for-any-reason notice, and Vendor holds the same walk-away right after the Initial Term. We add a Customer 30-day convenience exit with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and limit Vendor's convenience right to the end of a term on 90 days' notice. |
| 6 | High | ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control | Compliant | Preamble | Assignment permitted to an affiliate or successor by merger, stock or asset sale without consent; other assignments require consent not unreasonably withheld; no Vendor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control. Meets our fallback. |
| 7 | High | EXCLUSIVITY | Compliant | Preamble | Exclusivity expressly disclaimed; our right to monetise Inventory through other agents or directly is preserved. Section 5 is a default operating mechanic, not a sole-supplier obligation. |
| 8 | High | LD — Liquidated damages and penalties | Compliant | Preamble | No liquidated damages, penalties, shortfall payments or early-termination fees payable by Customer; Vendor's entitlement is limited to its revenue share during the notice period, and Section 14(d) prevailing-party fees are mutual. |
| 9 | High | NONCOMPETE | Compliant | Preamble | No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer; Section 1 confirms our freedom to use other agents and sell Inventory to third parties. Section 6 restrictions concern misuse and reverse engineering only. |
| 10 | Medium | GOVLAW — Governing law and venue | Deviation | Preamble | Delaware law with exclusive New York court jurisdiction (Section 14(a)) is within our accepted list, but Section 8 mandates AAA arbitration and conflicts with it. We delete the arbitration mandate and route disputes to the agreed New York courts. |
| 11 | Medium | RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice | Deviation | Preamble | Auto-renews in 12-month increments with no dedicated non-renewal mechanic; the only exit is a 90-day notice, longer than our 30-day window (60-day fallback). We add an express 30-day non-renewal notice right. Renewal length is acceptable and there is no price uplift under the revenue-share model. |
| 12 | Medium | WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration | Deviation | Preamble | Section 9(b) warranties are broad and run for the Term (industry-standard performance, freedom from errors materially affecting utility, security, no malicious code, compliance with Law, non-infringement) and Section 13 preserves them, but no remedy is specified. We add our re-performance / repair-or-replace / refund remedy without limiting other remedies. |
| 13 | Medium | TRANSITION — Post-termination assistance and data return | Missing | Preamble | Section 4(c) provides only that Vendor ceases the Services, the licence is revoked and Confidential Information is returned **or destroyed** — risking loss of our data, with no transition assistance or export obligation. We insert a wind-down paragraph: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in machine-readable format within 30 days, then certified deletion. |
| 14 | Medium | AUDIT — Audit rights against Customer | Compliant | Preamble | No audit, inspection, verification or books-and-records right exercisable by Vendor against us, and no access to our systems. Nothing to redline. |
| 15 | Medium | MFN | Compliant | Preamble | Section 5 covers revenue sharing per Exhibit and tax responsibility only; no MFN, "no less favourable terms" or price-matching obligation. |
| 16 | Medium | MINCOMMIT — Minimum commitments / volume restrictions | Compliant | Preamble | Compensation is a revenue share defined per Exhibit; no minimum purchase, committed spend, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume cap in the MSA. Exhibits to be re-checked when issued. |
| 17 | Medium | NOSOLICIT | Compliant | Preamble | No non-solicitation, no-hire or non-inducement covenant binding Customer. Nothing to redline. |
| 18 | Low | INSURANCE — Vendor insurance | Missing | Preamble | No insurance requirement at all, although Vendor hosts the Auction Platform and collects, manages and stores visitor data on our behalf (Section 9(b)(iii)). We insert an insurance paragraph in the General Provisions: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, certificates on request; fallback E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M. |

---

## 3. Walk-away items

The following must be resolved before signature:

1. **Aggregate limitation of liability (LOL-CAP, critical).** We cannot proceed with unlimited direct liability on both sides. We require the mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, with indemnities, confidentiality and data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement carved out as Excluded Claims, and payment obligations expressly excluded from "damages".
2. **Ownership of Customer Data and deliverables (IP, critical).** The Agreement's silence leaves our data and paid-for deliverables unprotected. We require an express statement of Customer ownership of Customer Data and deliverables, a licence-back for embedded Vendor IP, and a no-joint-ownership provision.
3. **Data return on termination (TRANSITION, medium — elevated).** Section 4(c)'s "return **or** destroy" option applied to our data is not acceptable without a guaranteed export path. We require return of Customer Data in machine-readable format within 30 days before any deletion.

---

## 4. Next steps

1. Issue our redline covering the five deviations and two missing items, marked with the **[Playbook]** comment prefix, with fallbacks noted where sensible (renewal notice 60 days; insurance E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
2. Flag the Section 8 / Section 14(a) conflict to Vendor as an internal inconsistency in their own draft — this should be an easy fix in our favour by deleting the arbitration mandate.
3. Hold the three walk-away items as a package for the first negotiation call; the eleven compliant positions can be confirmed as agreed to narrow the discussion.
4. Re-review each Exhibit when issued for minimum commitments, volume caps or pricing terms not present in the MSA, and for any exclusivity or MFN language introduced at the Exhibit level.
5. Request Vendor's certificates of insurance in parallel with the redline so cover can be verified against the levels we propose."}
